title: github/copilot-sdk: Embed the Copilot agent in applications and services
friendlyTitle: GitHub’s SDK puts the Copilot agent inside your own app
summary: GitHub’s multi-platform Copilot SDK exposes agent sessions, tools, hooks, MCP integrations and custom agents for applications and services. The project had about 10,300 total stars and added roughly 145 stars on GitHub’s daily Trending page when reviewed.
friendlySummary: The SDK lets developers add Copilot agent sessions, tools and custom behaviour to applications in several programming languages. It had about 10,300 GitHub stars when reviewed.
whyItMatters: Developers can use the SDK to add a managed Copilot agent to an existing product without building the full agent loop from scratch. Its setup, authentication and deployment guides are useful starting points, but teams should still define tool permissions, data boundaries and usage-cost controls.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it when you want Copilot to do tasks inside your service instead of only helping in an editor. Set strict access rules and spending limits before connecting important data or tools.
